rules.statement: When land which is owned in common has been amicably partitioned, a former co-owner is not, as a general rule, entitled to claim a right of way over a portion allotted to another co-owner unless it has been expressly granted or reserved in the cross-conveyances executed by the co-owners.
rules.supporting_quote: When land which is owned in common has been amicably partitioned, a former co-owner is not, as a general rule, entitled to claim a right of way over a portion allotted to another co-owner unless it has been expressly granted or reserved in the cross-conveyances executed by the co-owners, even though a well-defined footpath had existed prior to the severance of the common property.
